primary_comparison: paired mean best-validation NDCG@10; HR@10 secondary
checkpoint_selection: validation NDCG@10, then HR@10; earliest epoch on ties

supervision.click_infonce: click next-events only; observed exposures remain in history
supervision.all_infonce: exposure and click next-events with equal per-position weight

unknown_and_padding: excluded from supervised positions in both arms
budget: same model, data, initial shared weights, batch size, epochs and optimizer; not equal supervised positions or FLOPs
negative_sampling: same uniform train-visible pool and own-prefix rejection policy, 64 draws per position; actual draws differ when the position mask changes
test_policy: supplementary post-hoc ablation on a previously inspected cohort, not a new independent confirmation; do not change the original model/index selection
